hero.title: Welcome to Bennis Autoservice
hero.subtitle: Your car repair shop in Leipzig Plagwitz
hero.intro: Maintenance, repairs and personal service for your vehicle – reliable and right on site.

why.heading: Why Bennis Autoservice?
why.text: At Bennis Autoservice, personal advice, transparent agreements and careful workmanship are at the heart of everything we do.

services.heading: Services
services.intro: Whether it's routine maintenance, a necessary repair, or tracking down the cause of a problem: we take care of your vehicle professionally and agree on the required work transparently with you.

items: Help with maintenance, repairs and vehicle issues

items.heading: Inspection and maintenance
items.service: Regular maintenance work according to manufacturer specifications for the reliable and safe operation of your vehicle.

items.heading: Repairs
items.service: Professional repairs of mechanical and electrical vehicle components.

items.heading: Vehicle diagnostics
items.service: Reading out the fault memory and targeted inspection in case of warning lights, unusual noises or technical problems.

items.heading: Brake service
items.service: Inspection and replacement of brake pads, brake discs and other components of the braking system.

items.heading: Oil change
items.service: Oil and filter changes tailored to your vehicle's requirements.

items.heading: Tire service
items.service: Tire changes, tire condition inspection and tire pressure checks.

items.heading: Main inspection (TÜV)
items.service: Preparing your vehicle for the main inspection and carrying out any necessary repairs by prior arrangement.

items.heading: Other work
items.service: Need a different repair or not sure which service is required? Call us or send us an email. Together we'll figure out how we can help you.

Map.heading: Easy to find in the west of Leipzig
Map.paragraph1: You'll find Bennis Autoservice at Naumburger Straße 10 in the Leipzig district of Plagwitz – a neighborhood known for its striking industrial architecture and distinctive character.
Map.paragraph2: Our workshop is located right next to the POCO furniture store, making it easy to find. Use the map* to plan your route conveniently.
Map.note: *When using Google Maps, Google sets cookies that may be stored in your browser. By clicking "Plan route" you consent to the transfer of data to Google. Clicking "Hide map" stops any further tracking.
